faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the STPI Technical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the STPI Technical Officer positions is 10th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Technical Officer post, candidates need to have a B.E./B.Tech in ECE/CSE/IT/Instrumentation/EE/MCA/M.Sc(IT/EC) with 3 years of experience, or a 3 Years Polytechnic Diploma in ECE/CSE/IT/Instrumentation/BCA/BSC(IT/ETC) with 5 years of experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technical Officer post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be provided for deserving candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Technical Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Technical Officer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for STPI Technical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Technical Officer in this recruitment drive by STPI.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the STPI Technical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening by a Screening Committee, followed by a Personal Interview, and finally a recommendation by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. In which city and state is this STPI recruitment located?
faq.answer: This STPI recruitment is for a position located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link will be available on the STPI official website. You can find direct links in the "Important Links" section of this article.
